summary.text: Jeff Shipley is a Republican state representative from Iowa House District 87 who has served in the Iowa House since 2019 and is seeking re-election on November 3, 2026.
Ballotpedia lists his profession as legal advocate.

paragraphs.text: Jeff Shipley was born in Euclid, Ohio, and graduated from Naperville Central High School.
He earned a bachelor's degree in political science from the University of Iowa in 2010.

His career experience includes work as a sauerkraut salesman, a stand-up comedian and a legal advocate, and he has been affiliated with the Hazlitt Policy Center and the Southeast Iowa Mycological Society for the Advancement of Human Consciousness.
Shipley defeated incumbent Democrat Phil Miller in the November 6, 2018 general election for Iowa House District 82 and won re-election there in 2020.
In the redrawn District 87 he defeated incumbent Joe Mitchell in the June 7, 2022 Republican primary and Mike Heaton in the general election, and he won again in 2024.
For 2025-2026 Ballotpedia shows him assigned to the House Education and House Judiciary committees and as vice chair of the House Government Oversight Committee and of Higher Education.
He advanced from the June 2, 2026 Republican primary and faces Democrat Thomas O'Donnell in the general election.
